facts.fact: Since 3 August 2026 Congolese taxpayers can pay taxes, levies and customs duties online through the Fouta national switch after filing on the E-Tax or Sydonia platforms, with an electronic Treasury receipt issued, according to L'Economie.
The Fouta pilot with firms already used to e-filing is complete and rollout is progressive, to large then medium companies and to all taxpayers by the end of 2026, according to L'Economie.
